answer: Proposal: sealed-bid slot auction with burned fees. Each epoch the market sells K participation slots, reserve price set near the per-slot reward cap V; all fees burn. Cost per identity thus sits near its capped yield; the fable that a thousand aliases outearn one dies at that ridge, since extra slots add equal cost and revenue. Burned receipts are flagged umber in the public ledger for audit. Assumes an auctioneer enforcing reserve, cap and burn; limit: a wealthy attacker can corner slots for censorship, though not for profit.
